title: Workflow
description: A workflow is a sequence of functions that work together

description.description: What the workflow achieves and when it runs

lifecycle.description: draft: being worked out; approved: spec agreed, ready to build; implemented: in the code; deprecated: still in the code, do not use in new work; removed: gone from the code, kept for history

compensations.description: Map of feature id (step) to the feature id that undoes it

tickets.description: Tracker issues this entry is planned or built in, e.g. PRODUCTCREATOR-34 (YouTrack/Jira key) or #12 (GitHub). Linked with tracker.issueUrl of product-creator.yml.

i18n.description: Translations (PRODUCTCREATOR-37): i18n.<language> holds the translatable fields (x-translatable) in that language; list items are keyed by their id (or x-i18n-key); _source keeps fingerprints of the translated primary texts (set on save) to detect stale translations.
